passage: Composer Luana Pinto explained that she wanted to honor the significance of folk lullabies in Korean culture. prompt: According to the text, which piece of Pinto's music was performed at the Seoul Arts Center in 2018?

choices.B: An orchestral arrangement of a folk song
choices.D: A musical composition about Kim So-hee

explanation:
